selection_method: Within each radius-ordered bucket, retain first and last source records plus the minimum and maximum source records for normal optical depth and normalized signal power; deduplicate by source sample index. Phase values are carried through only at those selected source records and rendered as unconnected points; no phase continuity or extrema preservation is inferred.

variable_methods.phase_shift: values at deterministically selected source rows; unconnected point rendering with no continuity or extrema claim
